rows.note: Use this for someone who exposes their genitals or breasts in public.

example.english: The exhibitionist suddenly took off all their clothes in the park and shocked the passers-by.
example.traditional: 露體狂喺公園度突然除晒衫，嚇親晒啲途人。
example.jyutping: lou6 tai2 kwong4 hai2 gung1 jyun2 dou6 dat6 jin4 ceoi4 saai3 saam1 haak3 can1 saai3 di1 tou4 jan4

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose expression for someone who tries to attract attention through their behaviour.

example.english: They are such an exhibitionist, always trying to steal the spotlight in meetings.
example.traditional: 佢開會成日搶住講嘢，真係個出風頭嘅人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hoi1 wui2 seng4 jat6 coeng2 zyu6 gong2 je5 zan1 hai6 go3 ceot1 fung1 tau4 ge3 jan4
